title: The Corrupt Heart
body:
This Datapack introduces a block designed to bring players a new way of discovering the elusive Pale Garden biome. This pack is perfect for players who are exploring worlds where the Pale Garden biome doesn't naturally generate in large enough areas or are struggling to find a biome with a Creaking Heart. No need to wander aimlessly or cheat using seed maps to find Pale Garden biomes. Simply craft and build a Corrupt Heart!

### How It Works:
1. Craft the Corrupt Heart: To begin, craft the Corrupt Heart by combining a Heart of the Sea, 4 Obsidian, and 4 Glass. You can tell the difference between a Corrupt Heart and Crying Obsidian by the particles they give off. (I didn't feel custom blocks to be necessary in such a small pack)
2. Build the Structure: Place 5 moss blocks in a + shape and fill in the corners with iron blocks. Place the Corrupt Heart in the middle and mossy cobblestone in the four corners on top of the iron. Top the structure with 5 more mossy cobblestone blocks in a + shape.
3. Activate the Heart: Once the structure is complete, it will activate, creating a 50x50 Pale Garden biome around the Heart.

This pack is the perfect solution for players who want more control over biome generation and access to a Pale Garden biome, especially when they generate too small in existing hardcore or long-time worlds!
